lanes.notes: Runs the package type contract, including the intentionally permissive host-tag polymorphic surface.

divergences.upstreamResult: React forwards ref outside the ordinary prop-filtering path through forwardRef.
divergences.octaneResult: ref is a plain prop that always attaches to the rendered host and bypasses shouldForwardProp.
divergences.rationale: Octane components use ref-as-prop semantics and have no forwardRef wrapper.
divergences.consumerImpact: A shouldForwardProp callback cannot suppress ref attachment.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Treat ref as a reserved attachment prop rather than a filterable DOM prop.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adopts a separate React-compatible ref channel.

divergences.upstreamResult: Consumers collect styles through ServerStyleSheet and may interleave them with a Node stream.
divergences.octaneResult: The renderer automatically emits isolated CSS chunks; ServerStyleSheet remains compatible, while interleaveWithNodeStream throws.
divergences.rationale: Octane's server renderer owns CSS collection and stream ordering.
divergences.consumerImpact: SSR needs no collection wrapper or manual stream interleaving.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Read RenderResult.css or use the compatibility wrapper; remove interleaveWithNodeStream calls.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane delegates CSS collection to library-owned sheets.

divergences.upstreamResult: React applies component defaultProps at the component call boundary.
divergences.octaneResult: The styled factory resolves defaultProps during render and folding deep-merges them.
divergences.rationale: Octane call sites do not apply component defaultProps.
divergences.consumerImpact: Styled-component defaults and folded themes still resolve despite the renderer difference.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Assign defaultProps to styled components as usual.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane call sites gain defaultProps resolution.

divergences.upstreamResult: React JSX.IntrinsicElements narrows polymorphic host props per selected tag.
divergences.octaneResult: Host tags use a permissive prop bag while component targets retain inferred props.
divergences.rationale: Octane has no JSX.IntrinsicElements map to introspect.
divergences.consumerImpact: Invalid or cross-tag host props may not be rejected statically.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Validate host-specific polymorphic props in application types where strictness is required.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane publishes an intrinsic-element prop map.

divergences.upstreamResult: The upstream ecosystem supports a Babel transform for the css prop.
divergences.octaneResult: The package publishes only its runtime entry point and no Babel css-prop transform.
divergences.rationale: The Octane compiler does not integrate the upstream Babel transform.
divergences.consumerImpact: The css prop syntax is unavailable.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Create a styled component or use the css helper explicitly.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if an Octane css-prop compiler transform ships.

divergences.upstreamResult: Development builds probe React's dispatcher to detect styled() calls during render.
divergences.octaneResult: Development builds warn once after 200 creations sharing a displayName.
divergences.rationale: Octane exposes no React hook dispatcher to probe.
divergences.consumerImpact: Warnings are heuristic and appear only after repeated creation.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Define styled components outside render functions regardless of whether the warning fires.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane exposes a reliable render-phase probe.

divergences.upstreamResult: Version 6.4.3 constructs error 15 for unnamed Stylis plugins but does not throw it.
divergences.octaneResult: Unnamed Stylis plugins throw documented error 15.
divergences.rationale: Failing early preserves stable plugin identity and stylesheet hashing.
divergences.consumerImpact: Anonymous Stylis plugins are rejected immediately.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Give every Stylis plugin function a stable name.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream throws the documented error.

divergences.upstreamResult: Styled components are identified using React forward-ref identity alongside styled statics.
divergences.octaneResult: Plain-function styled components carry a dedicated Octane symbol brand.
divergences.rationale: Octane styled components do not use React forwardRef.
divergences.consumerImpact: Hoisted wrappers are not misidentified as styled components.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use isStyledComponent rather than inspecting internal symbols.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if styled components adopt a renderer-level wrapper identity.
